description:
Use this when the user asks a broad question about an Indian company listed on NSE or BSE ("how is X doing", "should I look at X"): a sourced report on quarterly and annual results, valuation, ownership, pledge, dividends and recent disclosures, no verdict. For one topic use get_financials, get_shareholding or get_stock_events.

Returns one report built from DalalOS's stored data: facts with their sources, calculations, the statements those support, recent events, and a `coverage` block naming what is missing. It draws on results, valuation history, returns, ownership and pledge, dividends, corporate actions, peers and recent disclosures. `query` is an NSE symbol, ISIN or BSE code; `days` (1 to 365, default 90) sets how far back disclosures are included. The default is a compact report: the latest three quarters and two years, material events in full and routine filings as a line each. `sections` returns the named sections in full, and `detail="full"` returns everything, which is too large for most clients to read.

detail.description: "compact" (default) leaves out older trend periods, quotes and audit hashes; "full" returns everything.
detail.title: Detail

query.description: One company: NSE symbol, ISIN or BSE code. A company name is not accepted.
query.title: Query

sections.description: Section ids to return in full, e.g. quarterly_performance or ownership; the reply lists the valid ids if one is unknown. Cannot be combined with detail=full.
sections.title: Sections

name: get_company_report
title: Company report
